name: johnnygrab
description: Record iOS Simulator videos and take screenshots sized for App Store Connect

johnnygrab.outputFolder.description: Folder where videos and screenshots are saved. ~ means your home folder.

johnnygrab.captureDelay.description: Seconds to wait after you press Record or Capture before JohnnyGrab starts, so the app can settle.

johnnygrab.statusBarTime.description: Status bar time used when Clean status bar is on. A local date and time like 2007-01-09T09:41:00 (Apple's 9:41) also sets the date; a plain time like 9:41 sets only the clock.
